name: Dixon Technologies

snapshot.about: Scaled electronics manufacturing services (EMS) player expanding into critical components and integrated electronics ecosystem.

narrative: Management's growth narrative aligns with IT hardware performance, where H1 FY27 revenue of ₹3,510 crore puts full-year guidance of 6,000 to ₹6,500 crore on track. However, FY26 mobile exports of ₹5,375 crore missed the promised 5,500 to ₹6,000 crore target.

actual_source.quote: In the present -- in the last fiscal, the exports was approximately INR5,375 crores

promises.note: Actual FY26 mobile exports were approximately ₹5,375 crore, below the 5,500 to ₹6,000 crore target.
